IC1: - Histologically confirmed diagnosis of supratentorial WHO Grade III or IV Glioma (High Grade Glioma) [AND] that has undergone surgical biopsy [OR] or resection followed by adjuvant chemoradiotherapy, [AND] that has evidence of recurrence [OR] or progression based on imaging studies [AND] and a stereotactic biopsy is indicated for confirmation of recurrence/ [OR] progression.
IC4: - MRI demonstration of a stereotactically accessible enhancing [OR] or predominantly non- enhancing mass [AND] that does [NOT] not require resection to relieve clinically significant mass effect;
IC5: - Participant understands the procedures and agrees to comply with the study requirements by providing written informed consent
IC6: - Adequate organ function as indicated in protocol
